questionSnapshot.question: In Sleeping Beauty (1959), what mountain region does the narrator call Maleficent's domain?

notes: Read final stem/all options; checked full topic/category digests, cross-bank candidate stems and options, category, scope, giveaways and editorial difficulty. Specified narrator mountain region to distinguish singular castle/mountain shorthand from exact plural narration. Two externally hosted transcriptions agree; no primary film copy inspected. Each alternative is a different region name, not another description of the same fortress. Raven name q323 is separate.
